title: FINDING THE SUBJECTIVE TRUTH: COLLECTING 2 MILLION VOTES FOR COMPREHENSIVE GEN-AI MODEL EVALUATION

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the geographic and continental distribution of human annotators against world population demographics to ensure cross-cultural representation and mitigate cultural bias in subjective model evaluations.
Tracking and analyzing the self-reported age and gender distributions of the annotator pool to prevent evaluation skew and reduce demographic representation biases.
Incorporating specific image generation prompts sourced from the HRS-Bench dataset, which are explicitly designed to evaluate bias and other subjective, contextual aspects of text-to-image models.
